function.description: Returns the names of all household items in the household scenario. It takes no input parameters. The result contains only a list of household item names and no other information.

Returns the category of a specified household item. Its only required parameter is item_name, which must be non-empty and exactly match a name in the household item records. The result contains only the category string.

Exactly matches a category and returns all household item names in it. Its only required parameter is category, which must be one of furniture, tableware, cookware, bedding, clothing, footwear, home_textile, storage_item, home_appliance, electronics, lighting, decoration, cleaning_item, daily_supply, or other. The parameter cannot be empty or omitted, and new categories cannot be invented. The result contains only a list of household item names.

Returns the ideal location for storing a specified household item when it is not in use. Its only required parameter is item_name, which must be non-empty and exactly match a name in the household item records. The result contains only the ideal_storage_location string.

Exactly matches a location and returns all household item names assigned to it. Its only required parameter is location, which must be one of living_room, dining_room, bedroom, study, wardrobe, linen_closet, shoe_cabinet, kitchen_cabinet, pantry, bathroom_cabinet, laundry_area, storage_room, bookshelf, display_shelf, balcony, or garage. The parameter cannot be empty or omitted, and new locations cannot be invented. The result contains only a list of household item names.

Returns the purchase date of a specified household item. Its only required parameter is item_name, which must be non-empty and exactly match a name in the household item records. The result is a YYYY-MM-DD date string, or null when the purchase date is unknown.

Returns all household item names whose purchase dates fall within the specified inclusive range; items with a null purchase_date are excluded. Its two required parameters are start_date and end_date, both non-empty YYYY-MM-DD strings; start_date cannot be later than end_date. The result contains only a list of household item names.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.description: Returns the purchase_price of a specified household item. Its only required parameter is item_name, which must be non-empty and exactly match a name in the household item records. The result contains only the purchase price.

Returns all household item names whose purchase_price falls within the specified inclusive range. Its two required parameters are min_price and max_price, both numbers greater than or equal to zero; neither may be omitted, and min_price cannot exceed max_price. The result contains only a list of household item names.

Returns the usage periods of a specified household item. Its only required parameter is item_name, which must be non-empty and exactly match a name in the household item records. The result is a list of START/END strings: START may be YYYY-MM-DD or PURCHASE_DATE, and END may be YYYY-MM-DD or PRESENT. It returns an empty list when there is no usage history.

Returns household items with at least one usage_history period overlapping the specified inclusive date range. The system resolves PURCHASE_DATE using the item's purchase_date and PRESENT using the current date. Its two required parameters are start_date and end_date, both non-empty YYYY-MM-DD strings; start_date cannot be later than end_date. The result contains only a list of household item names.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.description: Returns the maintenance records of a specified household item. Each record contains only date and action, where action is one of clean, condition, disinfect, wash, or inspect. Its only required parameter is item_name, which must be non-empty and exactly match a name in the household item records.

Returns a dictionary of maintenance and usage instructions for the requested household items, including periodic maintenance actions and the maximum service life. Its only required parameter is item_name, which must be a non-empty list of exact names from the household item records. Each result key is an item name and its value is that item's instructions.

item_name.description: Non-empty list of exact household item names.

function.description: Appends one new household action on every successful call and never updates, replaces, or removes an existing entry. The same name and required_action may therefore have multiple scheduled entries, including entries with different due dates. Its four required parameters are user_id, name, required_action, and due_date. name must exactly match a household item record. required_action must be one of: clean (wipe or dust without washing), condition (wax, oil, polish, moisture-proof, waterproof, or otherwise protect), disinfect (sanitize), wash (hand-, machine-, or water-wash), inspect (check structure, function, safety, and wear), repair (fix damage or replace a local part without replacing the whole item), relocate (return to the ideal storage location), dry (air- or machine-dry after washing), iron (press clothing or household textiles), replace (retire and obtain or use a replacement), or dispose (remove without obtaining a replacement). due_date must be a YYYY-MM-DD string. No parameter may be empty or omitted. The result contains only an addition success message.

Removes only the action whose name, required_action, and due_date all exactly match an entry in the specified user's list. Its four required parameters are user_id, name, required_action, and due_date. required_action must be one of clean, condition, disinfect, wash, inspect, repair, relocate, dry, iron, replace, or dispose. due_date must be a YYYY-MM-DD date and exactly match the stored due date. No parameter may be empty or omitted. The result contains only a removal success message; an error is returned when no action matches all three fields.

due_date.description: Due date of the exact action to remove in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.description: Returns all current household-item actions for a specified user. Its only required parameter is user_id, which cannot be empty or omitted. Each returned entry contains only name, required_action, and due_date.
